book.scene: One page a night at the kitchen table. Fourteen drawings to colour, a few words to talk about on every page, and one empty page for the ending your child draws.
book.materials: White uncoated paper, 60 lb (about 90 g/m²), FSC-certified, acid-free and lead-free, with a light texture made for pencils and crayons. Matte laminated cover on 100 lb stock. Perfect bound with a glued spine, the strong, flexible kind used in bookshop paperbacks. Made for you after you order.
inside: A welcome page with a QR code to send Pim your child’s ending
14 drawings to colour, each on a right-hand page
A short conversation guide for the grown-up facing every drawing: one question or one good word
One empty last page where your child draws the ending
book.care: Best with pencils and crayons. Thick markers can show through, so every drawing sits on a right-hand page.
book.safety: For colouring with a grown-up nearby. Keep the packaging away from children.
specs: White uncoated paper, 60 lb (about 90 g/m²), with a light texture for pencils and crayons
Black-and-white line art, premium ink with heavy coverage; drawings on right-hand pages only
Matte laminated, 100 lb cover stock, Telning green edge to edge
Perfect bound: a glued spine, the bookshop paperback kind
Printed to order, in the printing network nearest to you

story.3-5: Seven o’clock, the lights are low, the book is open on the duvet. Tonight’s page: {first} You read the small question on the left, your child picks a crayon, and you talk about what happens next. One page a night, fourteen nights. Then the big question: {choice} The last page is empty. That is where your child draws the answer.
story.5-7: After school, at the kitchen table, two pages before dinner. {first} Your child colours, you ask the question on the left, and the talk goes further than the page. Then the big question: {choice} The last page is empty: your child draws the ending there, and signs it.

poster.scene: A rainy Saturday, the Story Wall taped to the hallway wall: your child, a friend and Grandma each take a corner of the picture. About a third is already in colour; the rest is theirs. Then frame it and hang it.
facts: About 30% in flat colour, 70% to colour
poster.materials: Thick matte paper, 189 g/m² and 0.26 mm, acid-free, with no shine, so it is easy to frame. 94% opacity, so felt-tips do not show the wall behind. Made for you after you order and shipped rolled in a tube. 100 × 70 cm is a standard frame size.
poster.care: Colour with pencils, crayons or felt-tips. Put a sheet of card under the Story Wall when you use felt-tips. Lay it flat under a few books for a day after unrolling.
poster.safety: Keep the tube and the packaging away from small children.
specs: 100 × 70 cm, landscape, a standard frame size
Thick matte paper, 189 g/m², 0.26 mm, opacity 94%, acid-free
About 30% printed in flat Telning colours; the rest clean black outlines, thick enough for small hands
Matte, no shine, so it frames without reflections
Pencils, crayons or felt-tips (card underneath for felt-tips)
Rolled in a sturdy tube, in its own parcel
Printed to order in Europe for Europe and the UK, and in the US for the US and Canada; for indoor use
poster.story: Saturday morning, rain on the window. You unroll the {series} Story Wall and tape it to the hallway wall, as wide as the door. Your child takes one corner, a friend takes another, and Grandma starts on the sky. {third} By lunch the first corner is done; the rest fills up over the next weekends. When it is finished, it goes into a frame, and the {theme} world stays on the wall.

storyThird.3-5: About a third is already in colour; the big shapes are theirs.
storyThird.5-7: About a third is already in colour; the small details are theirs.

mug.scene: Seven o’clock, warm milk in your mug, while you ask which ending your child chose today. For the grown-up who reads the story every night.
mug.materials: White glazed ceramic with a glossy finish, 11 oz (330 ml), 9.6 cm tall and 8.2 cm across. The print wraps around the mug. Made for you after you order.
mug.care: Dishwasher and microwave safe. Hand washing keeps the print bright for longer.
mug.safety: For hot drinks: take care with small children nearby.
specs: 11 oz (330 ml), 9.6 cm tall, 8.2 cm across
Wraps around the mug, bright and made to last through the dishwasher
Printed to order in Europe or North America
mug.story: Seven o’clock in the morning, the kettle on, the day’s first page still to come. The mug lands on the table and your child points at it: {words} That is the ending they chose last night. You drink your coffee; they tell the story again, a little longer each day. For the grown-up who reads every night.
mug.storyHalloween: A dark October evening, cocoa for the small one, tea for you. {line} Your child looks at the mug and starts retelling last night’s ending, with sound effects. By the end of the week, every cup of cocoa comes with a story.

tote.scene: Library day. The book, the crayons, the spare socks and a snack all go in the grown-up’s bag, and the story comes along.
facts: Straps 62 cm, fits on the shoulder
tote.materials: 100% certified organic cotton in a 3/1 twill, 272 g/m² (8 oz/yd²), GOTS and OCS certified, with OEKO-TEX certified fabric. 40.6 × 35.6 × 12.7 cm, two 62 cm straps, carries up to 13.6 kg. Printed with water-based inks. Made for you after you order, in Europe or North America.
tote.care: Wash at 30°C inside out. Do not iron on the print. Do not tumble dry.
tote.safety: Not a toy. Keep the straps away from small children.
specs: 100% certified organic cotton, 3/1 twill, 272 g/m² (8 oz/yd²)
Two straps, 2.5 cm wide and 62 cm long; fits on the shoulder
Up to 13.6 kg: books, crayons and the shopping
Water-based inks, printed into the fabric
GOTS and OCS organic cotton; OEKO-TEX certified fabric
Wash at 30°C inside out; no tumble dry; do not iron on the print
Printed to order in Europe or North America
tote.story: Library day. The book goes in first, then the crayons, the spare socks and a snack. On the bus your child finds Pim on the bag and tells the lady opposite how the story ended. On the way home it carries three new books and one very tired child.
tote.storyHalloween: The lantern walk on the 31st. The bag carries the book, the crayons and far too many sweets. {line} Your child finds it on the bag and tells the neighbours how last night’s story ended. On the way home it carries the lantern too.

postcards.scene: Sunday evening at the kitchen table: your child tells you what to write, you write it, and Grandma keeps the card on the fridge.
postcards.materials: Matte card, 300 g/m², FSC/PEFC certified, A6 (10.5 × 14.8 cm) with rounded corners. The back has space for a message and an address. Delivered to Europe and the UK only; not available in the US and Canada. Made for you after you order.
postcards.care: Write with a pen or a pencil. Ballpoint and felt-tip both work on the matte back.
postcards.safety: Keep the packaging away from small children.
specs: Matte card, 300 g/m²: takes pen, pencil and felt-tip
Space for a message and an address
Europe and the UK only; not available in the US and Canada
Printed to order in Europe or the UK
postcards.story: Sunday evening at the kitchen table. Your child says what to write, you write it down word for word, and they sign it with a drawing. Grandma keeps it on the fridge for a year. Ten cards: ten Sundays, ten stories told again.
postcards.storyHalloween: An evening in October, orange leaves on the table. {line} Your child says what to write to a cousin, you write it, and they draw a small pumpkin next to the stamp. Ten cards for ten friends, each with the story of one ending.

cards.scene: A card from Grandpa, blank inside for his own words, and an envelope your child insists on licking shut.
facts: Pack of 10, one design, with envelopes
cards.materials: Folded matte card, 350 g/m², FSC certified, square corners, blank inside. 14.1 × 14.1 cm in Europe, the UK and the rest of the world; 5.25 × 5.25 in in the US and Canada. Comes with 10 white envelopes made of 100% recycled, FSC/PEFC-certified paper: 145 g/m² in the EU, 120 g/m² elsewhere. Made for you after you order.
cards.care: Blank inside for your own words. Write with any pen.
cards.safety: Keep the packaging away from small children.
specs: 10 folded cards of one design, with 10 envelopes
Square, 14.1 × 14.1 cm folded, square corners (5.25 × 5.25 in in the US and Canada)
Matte card, 350 g/m², blank inside for your own words
White, 100% recycled: 145 g/m² in the EU, 120 g/m² elsewhere
Printed to order, close to you
cards.story: A birthday morning. Grandpa writes four words inside, your child draws the rest, and the envelope gets licked shut twice to be sure. The card stands on the shelf for weeks. Ten cards for ten birthdays, each one blank inside for your own words.
cards.storyHalloween: The last week of October. A card for the neighbours, one for the cousins, one for the teacher. {line} Your child draws last night’s ending inside, you write the names. Ten cards, blank inside, for everyone who likes a pumpkin on the doorstep.

delivery: Made for you after you order. EU 3–10 working days, US/UK/Canada 3–7 working days. Items may arrive in separate parcels. Unused items can be returned within 14 days. If it arrives damaged or wrong, we replace it.
separateParcel: Items may arrive in separate parcels: books, Story Walls and gifts are each made in their own workshop.

trust.t: Nothing waits in a warehouse. Every book, Story Wall and gift is made after you order it, as close to you as we can.
Premium FSC-certified paper, GOTS-certified organic cotton, OEKO-TEX certified fabric. Each claim sits next to its certificate on Our materials.
Every story is created by the Telning team of cognitive and behavioural scientists, and designed in Sweden.
